This sample is part of the "PPG MULTISAMPLE 003 Lfoed"
sample pack. It is an experimental sound effect, suitable for
experimental music or as a sound effect. It consists of a texture with
some LFO
and fades on it. In the sample pack there are 16 samples evenly spread
across 5 octaves (C1 till C6). The note in the sample name (C, E or G#)
does not indicate the pitch of the sound but the key on my keyboard.
The sound was created on the PPG VSTi. After that normalising and fades where applied within Cubase SX.
